Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 18

“These bodies of the eternal embodied one — indestructible and immeasurable — are said to have an end. Therefore fight, Bharata.”

Krishna finally connects philosophy to the order. Bodies end regardless; that fact does not license cruelty, it removes Arjuna's belief that he is the one deciding whether these men are mortal.
